Collapse File C funding records to annual outlays per award

Source: R/api-outlays.R
us_outlays_by_year.Rd

Turns the period-level funding table into one row per award x federal fiscal year, applying the cumulative-within-year rule that gross_outlay_amount requires: within each account cell (federal account x DEFC x object class x program activity x funding agency) the annual outlay is the last reported value of the fiscal year, and the award-year outlay is the sum over cells. transaction_obligated_amount is incremental, so it sums directly; it is returned as filec_obligation so the caller can check File C against the award's own transaction ledger – the linkage screen us_add_outlays() runs per award.

Usage

us_outlays_by_year(funding)

Arguments

funding

A data.table matching us_schema("funding"), from us_fetch_outlays().

Value

A data.table of award_key, fiscal_year, outlay (NA when the award-year reported no outlay rows, never a fake zero), filec_obligation, and n_periods.

Details

Years are federal fiscal years; File C has no calendar-year form.
